details.description:
From the house of Kissan, we bring you Kissan Fables - a premium fruit spread where each pack is a storybook, telling a fable of magical fruits and unique combinations. A story of 100% fruits, and nothing else.
Carefully crafted recipe that has just 5 ingredients and that too all from fruits! Including natural sweetness that comes just from fruits. No added refined sugars at all, just fruit & fruit and only fruits!
And not to our surprise, no nasties at all - No added colours, preservatives, flavours and of course not even refined sugar.
Each variant is carefully crafted with unique fruit combinations to give you the best flavour and is gently cooked to retain fruits’ original taste, flavour, and colours.
Tastes amazing with bread, roti, pancakes or may be with vanilla ice-cream or cheese cake and tell us if you try anything else, we'll recommend it to others too.
And as a proof of how this product is just 100% fruit and literally nothing else not even preservatives, if you keep the product outside fridge after opening it, you’ll see fungus on it, just like how you see it on real fruits. Hence, we recommend refrigerating it after opening.
details.ingredients: Fruit Pulps-50% (Blueberry, Mulberry), Date Juice Concentrate, Apple Juice Concentrate, Citrus Pectin (Gelling Agent)

details.description:
Indulge in the rich, creamy goodness of Kissan Creamy Peanut Butter, crafted with real peanuts handpicked from the farms of Gujarat. This protein-packed spread is an excellent choice for mothers seeking nutritious options for their children, providing the same amount of protein as a glass of cow's milk in just a 30g serving. Boasting a remarkable 25% protein content, Kissan Peanut Butter surpasses the protein levels of eggs, milk, lentils, poultry, and fish, making it one of the richest plant-based protein sources available.
Enjoy the versatility of this delectable spread, elevating the flavour of your favourite foods, from smoothies and oatmeal to cookies and cakes. The convenient bottle packaging and resealable top ensure you can savour the nutty, fresh taste of Kissan Peanut Butter whenever the craving strikes, without compromising on quality or nutrition. With no added colours, flavours, or preservatives, this premium peanut butter is the perfect choice for health-conscious families seeking a protein-rich, all-natural treat.

details.description:
Experience the vibrant and authentic flavours of Kissan Chatpati Hari Chutney, a delightful condiment crafted with fresh coriander, mint, and green chillies. Inspired by traditional Indian recipes, this chutney delivers a tangy and zesty twist to your meals, enhanced by its rustic silbatta-like texture that mimics hand-ground masalas. Made with fresh ingredients sourced from trusted Indian farms, every spoonful guarantees purity and bold flavours.
This versatile chutney pairs effortlessly with a variety of dishes. Spread it on sandwiches, enjoy it as a dip for samosas and pakoras, or drizzle it over chaats for a burst of flavour. It complements kebabs, theplas, and even adds a unique Indian twist to avocado toast. Whether you're hosting a gathering or preparing everyday meals, this chutney is your go-to for enhancing flavours.
Packaged to preserve its strong and tangy taste, Kissan Chatpati Hari Chutney is ready to eat and easy to store. Simply refrigerate after opening to maintain its freshness for months. Perfect for pairing with Kissan tomato ketchup or tomato sauce dishes, this chutney is a must-have for those who love sauces with a unique twist. Elevate your culinary creations with the exceptional taste of Kissan, a trusted name in condiments, including their popular ketchup range. Add this chutney to your pantry and enjoy a flavorful journey through India in every bite.

Savour the authentic taste of Maharashtra with Kissan Chilli Peanut Thecha Chutney, a delightful fusion of spice and nuttiness. Crafted with roasted peanuts, fresh green chillies, and aromatic garlic sourced from trusted Indian farms, this chutney offers a bold, flavorful experience. Its silbatta-like texture, reminiscent of traditional hand-pounded recipes, ensures every bite bursts with heritage and authenticity.
This versatile chutney is perfect for enhancing your favourite dishes. Pair it with Indian breads like parathas, theplas, or bhakris, or use it to add a spicy kick to snacks such as pakoras and batata vadas. It's an excellent alternative to tomato ketchup or tomato sauce, bringing a unique twist to wraps, rice bowls, and marinations. Stir it into yoghurt for a creamy, tangy dip or use it as a flavour-packed addition to your everyday meals.
Kissan Chilli Peanut Thecha Chutney is ready-to-eat and conveniently packaged to preserve its freshness and rich flavours. Unlike traditional tomato ketchup or tomato sauce, this chutney delivers a bold and nutty taste that stands out in any dish. Whether you're a fan of syrups & sauces or looking for a distinctive condiment, this chutney is a must-have for your kitchen.
Experience a perfect blend of tradition and spice with Kissan Chilli Peanut Thecha Chutney - a flavorful companion for those who crave authentic Indian taste.

details.description:
We make Kissan Juicy Orange Squash with naturally ripened oranges
handpicked from renowned farms. Kissan Juicy Orange Squash also contains the
goodness of fruit vitamins A, B, and C. Enjoy a delightfully refreshing orange
drink that tastes just like fresh orange juice whenever you feel tired.
It is a great drink to enjoy on a hot summer day. You can quickly make
about 5 litres or 25 glasses from one pack of Kissan Juicy Orange Squash, as
per the serving suggestion of 210 ml (180 ml of water and 30 ml of Kissan Juicy
Orange Squash).
Easily prepare your refreshing orange drink by mixing one part of
Kissan Juicy Orange Squash with six parts of chilled water or soda — or simply
mix 2 tablespoonfuls (30 ml) of the squash with one glass (180 ml) of water or
chilled soda.
You can also use Kissan Juicy Orange Squash to make a refreshing iced
tea or mocktails. Enjoy the taste of real orange juice in every sip!
Kissan Juicy Squash also comes in delightful Juicy Lemon, Juicy Grape,
Juicy Pineapple, and Juicy Mango flavours. Started in 1934, Kissan is a popular
Indian brand known for its range of jams, ketchups, sauces, and peanut butter.
